title: Fix warnings in CI
body:
Although a recent MR (!3919) fixed a lot of warnings, there were still some not-necessarily-closed files in lammpsrun and assorted other issues.

In oldlibs, pytest does not see pyproject.toml, which means it doesn't recognize markers, warning settings, etc.  Probably it does not pick up pyproject.toml when the tests run from within an installation (since the tests are installed as part of the source, which is arguably not what we should do).  With this MR, more tests jobs run from editable installations, although a better long-term solution would be to not install the tests.  Or alternatively we can use conftest.py (which *is* installed) to control markers and warnings.

Additional resource fixes in lammpsrun (which is very messy).

Fix non-windows-compatible BAOAB tests.

With this change the windows tests pass and we have no warnings (although I took the liberty of silencing those about binary incompatibility that we always get).
